Configure PaddleOCR language, model tier, and model version

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { ExtractInput, ExtractInputKind, ExtractionConfig, extract } from "@xberg-io/xberg";
async function main() {
  const input: ExtractInput = { kind: ExtractInputKind.Uri, mimeType: "image/png", uri: "https://example.com/images/test_hello_world.png" };
  const config: ExtractionConfig = { ocr: { backend: "paddleocr", enabled: true, language: ["en"], paddleOcrSettings: { language: "en", modelTier: "mobile", modelVersion: "pp-ocrv6" } } };
  const result = await extract(input, config);
  console.log(result.results?.[0]?.content);
}

void main();
```
